title: healthy CD4 T cells 1
source_name_ch1: Peripheral blood from healthy individuals

extract_protocol_ch1: Qiagen Rneasy mini column; only high quality RNA samples as assessed by BioAnalyzer were hybridized to the GeneChips
label_protocol_ch1: Biotinylated cRNA was prepared according to the Affymetrix protocol from at least 5 ug of high quality RNA
hyb_protocol: Following fragmentation, hybridization was carried out according to the Affymetrix Expression Analysis Technical Manual; only samples passing stringent quality control guidelines were assessed
scan_protocol: Affymetrix arrays were scanned using the Affymetrix GeneChip Scanner 3000 System
description: Gene expression data from freshly sorted cells
data_processing: Data was analyzed with Microarray Suite version 5.0 (MAS 5.0) software using the Affymetrix default analysis settings and global scaling normalization methods.

treatment_protocol_ch1: PBMC were isolated, tagged with fluorochrome-conjugated antibodies to CD3, CD4, CD19 and CD33 for 30 min. PBMC were sorted into subsets on a Cytomation MoFlo cytometer into individual subsets. Purity of the populations was confirmed after sorting.
extract_protocol_ch1: Qiagen Rneasy mini column; only high quality RNA samples as assessed by BioAnalyzer were hybridized to the GeneChips
label_protocol_ch1: Biotinylated cRNA was prepared according to the Affymetrix protocol from at least 5 ug of high quality RNA
hyb_protocol: Following fragmentation, hybridization was carried out according to the Affymetrix Expression Analysis Technical Manual; only samples passing stringent quality control guidelines were assessed
scan_protocol: Affymetrix arrays were scanned using the Affymetrix GeneChip Scanner 3000 System
description: Gene expression data from freshly sorted cells
data_processing: Data was analyzed with Microarray Suite version 5.0 (MAS 5.0) software using the Affymetrix default analysis settings and global scaling normalization methods.
